summary.text: Taner Demirci Lopez, a Libertarian Party scholar and former college professor, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Virginia's 7th District to Eugene Vindman.
According to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, he later worked as a cultural advisor to U.S. government agencies.

paragraphs.text: Demirci Lopez describes himself as a U.S. citizen raised in a multicultural family who studied Spanish language and literature.

According to his survey, he earned a master's degree in Religions and Cultures and a doctorate in Theology from the University of Murcia in Spain, which led to a career as a scholar and college professor.
He says he later left academia to work as a cultural advisor supporting several U.S. government agencies.
He says he joined the Libertarian Party because he believes the two-party system has failed to represent Americans.
He said he was running on restoring national independence, reducing federal spending and taxation, and reforming immigration policy.
He received 0.8% of the vote to Eugene Vindman's 59.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
